about.eyebrow: // digital entrepreneur · ai consultant · content creator
about.headline: Builder, creator, entrepreneur.
about.subheadline: I build in the AI era and share everything along the way with a 400K+ community.
bio: Started in digital marketing. Moved into product and AI. Built in public, and a community of 400K+ people started paying attention.
Today I run an independent practice: AI consulting for ambitious teams, content that teaches real skills, and software that solves real problems.
about.skills_title: What I bring to the table.

skills.name: Product strategy
skills.description: Translating vision into actionable roadmaps. I help teams identify what to build, for whom, and in what order, balancing user needs with business constraints.

skills.name: Full-stack development
skills.description: From database schema to UI polish. I ship production-grade web applications using Next.js, TypeScript, and modern infrastructure that scales.

skills.name: AI implementation
skills.description: Integrating LLMs and AI workflows into real products. Not demos. Systems that reduce costs, accelerate output, and improve decision-making.

skills.name: Content systems
skills.description: Building repeatable content engines. I design workflows, templates, and distribution pipelines that turn ideas into consistent audience growth.

skills.name: Growth operations
skills.description: Data-driven experimentation across acquisition, activation, and retention. I set up the metrics, tools, and rituals that compound over time.

skills.name: Team architecture
skills.description: Structuring teams for velocity and clarity. I help define roles, workflows, and communication rhythms that let talent thrive.
